'''Sergio''' is an NPC that appears in [[Montelli Quarter]], [[Ragunna]].

From 2:00 PM to 5:59 PM, he's talking with [[Lyubov]] and [[Sofia]]. Meanwhile, From 9:00 PM to 10:59 PM, he can be seen talking to [[Michele]].

==Idle Quotes==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;<nowiki>(6:00 AM to 1:59 PM)</nowiki>
:'''Sergio:''' Scandal in Serene Bay! Forbidden Lovers EXPOSED—A Fairytale or Total Disgrace?
:'''Sergio:''' These Announcements Bishop Fenrico To Drop on Carnevale Will BLOW YOUR MIND—Learn How it Will Affect Your Wallet.
:'''Sergio:''' I asked Michele to bring me some newspaper and what in the name of Imperator are these?
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;<nowiki>(2:00 PM to 5:59 PM)</nowiki>
:'''Lyubov:''' Excuse me, could you get me this clam! And this wind chime too.
:'''Sergio:''' Alright, that'll be 220 Monnaie.
:'''Lyubov:''' What? What's a Monnaie?
:'''Sofia:''' You're mistaken, Mister!
:'''Sofia:''' Monnaie is long outdated by now!
:'''Sofia:''' Now we use Shell Credit for payments as the rest of Solaris does. Monnaie has become just a souvenir of Ragunna.
:'''Sergio:''' Oh, yeah... you are right.
:'''Sergio:''' It feels like just yesterday we were still using Monnaie... I'm getting old...
:'''Sergio:''' Now I remember the time when Averardo Bank collected Monnaie to exchange new notes for us.
:'''Sergio:''' Oh, right, that'll be 220 Shell Credits, young lady.
----
;<nowiki>(9:00 PM to 10:59 PM)</nowiki>
:'''Sergio:''' Showing up this late, the dish is nearly cold! This was saved especially for your grandmother.
:'''Michele:'''Thank you, Uncle Sergio!
:'''Sergio:''' Who's your Uncle?
:'''Michele:'''What?
:'''Sergio:''' Call me "Sir"!
:'''Michele:'''Alright... Sir... Sergio.
:'''Sergio:''' Hmph, that's more like it. Here, is a balm specially made for Septimont gladiators—it's top-notch! Take it back to Giovanni.
:'''Sergio:''' Poor young lad... thrown his back out getting headbutted by a Tumbleyak...
:'''Michele:'''I must insist on paying you!
:'''Sergio:''' Quit your babbling! As if I'd take your money!
:'''Sergio:''' Apollonia is waiting for your proposal...
:'''Michele:''' I just got a promising new job. Once I make a name for myself, I'll—
:'''Sergio:''' Hold it... Don't make my daughter wait forever, or there'll be consequences!
{{Dialogue End}}
